items.title: Trellix Source Code Breach – Hackers Gain Unauthorized Access to Repository
items.description: Cybersecurity giant Trellix has disclosed a significant security incident involving unauthorized access to a portion of its source code repository. The company confirmed the breach in an official statement published on its website, stating it immediately engaged leading forensic experts upon discovering the intrusion.
